p.i: A revelation given at Kirtland, Ohio, 10 June 1831, through Joseph Smith Jr. to Newel Knight.

chapter.li: LEChapter54 Verse1 Behold, thus says the Lord, even Alpha and Omega, the Beginning and the End, even he who was crucified for the sins of the world: VerseEnd Verse2 Behold, truly, truly I say unto you my servant Newel, you shall stand fast in the office wherewith I have appointed you. VerseEnd Verse3 And if your brethren desire to escape their enemies, let them repent of all their sins and become truly humble before me and contrite. VerseEnd Verse4 And as the covenant which they made unto me has been broken, even so, it has become void and of none effect. VerseEnd Verse5 And woe to him by whom this offense comes, for it had been better for him that he had been drowned in the depth of the sea. VerseEnd Verse6 But blessed are they who have kept the covenant and observed the commandment, for they shall obtain mercy. VerseEnd

Verse7 Wherefore, go to now and flee the land, so that your enemies don't come upon you, and take your journey, and appoint whom you will to be your leader and to pay moneys for you. VerseEnd Verse8 And thus you shall take your journey into the regions westward, unto the land of Missouri, unto the borders of the Lamanites. VerseEnd Verse9 And after you have done journeying, behold, I say unto you, seek a living like unto men, until I prepare a place for you. VerseEnd Verse10 And again, be patient in tribulation until I come. And behold, I come quickly and my reward is with me, and they who have sought me early shall find rest to their souls. Even so, Amen. VerseEnd
